title: fix(spec): a lazySchema reference keeps its authored description in z.toJSONSchema
body:
Fixes #19101

Clause-②: no

<sub>Rewritten short by the `domain:spec#5` seat (2026-09-24T01:31Z; one count cut after record `5805815738`). The dev reports are on #19101 (`5805027961`, `5805539465`), and the seat ruling is `5805064236`.</sub>

A schema referenced through a `lazySchema` Proxy lost its authored `.describe()` text in `z.toJSONSchema`. zod reads metadata from a registry keyed on object identity; the node it holds is the Proxy, while the description was registered on the real instance. The shipped JSON Schemas were therefore built lazily and missed those descriptions. Under `OS_EAGER_SCHEMAS=1`, where there is no Proxy, they were present.

## What changed

- `packages/spec/src/shared/lazy-schema.ts`: the facade's `processJSONSchema` wrapper registers the real instance's metadata on the Proxy in the registry the conversion reads. It does this once, never over an existing entry, and leaves out `id`: aliasing `id` makes zod throw "Duplicate schema id".
- Measured by the dev, lazy after the fix against eager, leaf by leaf, with 0 diffs in each corpus:
  - the `openapi.json` components gain 2 descriptions;
  - the `os generate` IDE schema gains 445.

  Only `description` moves, and eager output is unchanged.
- Pins in `lazy-schema.test.ts`. Deleting the alias call turns 4 of them red; deleting the `id` exclusion turns the `id` pin red.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/spec` patch.

## Not in this PR

- An eager run of `gen:openapi` still crashes on a `src` import cycle, and the same cycle crashes the published `/api` and `/data` entries under `OS_EAGER_SCHEMAS=1`: #19930.
